name: How do I know if converting my tub to a shower is the right decision?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if converting my tub to a shower is the right decision?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion is practical if your household rarely uses the bathtub, struggles with stepping over high tub walls, or wants a modern look. It is an ideal solution for homeowners seeking better accessibility or accommodating multigenerational living arrangements. However, keeping at least one functional bathtub elsewhere in the residence is usually recommended for bathing small children or pets. If your home has only one bathroom, consider whether removing the sole tub aligns with your daily routine and future resale plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting is ideal if you rarely take baths or need barrier-free accessibility, provided you evaluate whether your household still requires a tub for small children or pets.
